source.author: verg
source.text: Nempe abruptis turbata procellis nocte natat caeca serus freta; quem super ingens porta tonat caeli et scopulis illisa reclamant aequora; nec miseri possunt revocare parentes nec moritura super crudeli funere virgo.
source.text_original: Nempe abruptis turbata procellis / nocte natat caeca serus freta; quem super ingens / porta tonat caeli et scopulis illisa reclamant / aequora; nec miseri possunt revocare parentes / nec moritura super crudeli funere virgo.
source.text_english: Certainly in a night thrown into confusion by burst storms the blind sea swims late; over it the mighty gate of heaven thunders, and the waters, dashed against the rocks, roar back; nor can the wretched parents recall their child, nor the maiden, about to die, above her cruel funeral pyre.

reuse.author: hier
reuse.text: totam circa insulam fremit insanum mare et sinuosis montibus illisum scopulis aequor reclamat; nullo terra gramine uiret; nullis uernans campus densatur umbraculis; abruptae rupes quasi quondam horroris carcerem claudunt.
reuse.text_original: totam circa insulam fremit insanum mare et sinuosis montibus illisum scopulis aequor reclamat; nullo terra gramine uiret; nullis uernans campus densatur umbraculis; abruptae rupes quasi quondam horroris carcerem claudunt.
reuse.text_english: All around the island the mad sea roars, and the surface of the water, dashed against those winding cliffs, echoes back from the rocks; no land is green with grass; no field, blooming in spring, is thick with leafy shade; sheer crags enclose it like the prison of some former terror.
